title: Regime necessity and the $\rho_F$ prefactor for the doubly-magic binding formula
html:
Necessity of a separate doubly-magic formula

The framework's two binding paths apply to distinct categorical regimes:

Regime Path Categorical content
Hyperbolic \mathfrak{B} = \mathfrak{m}_e \cdot \rho_0 \cdot \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T(p, k)) per-rep Reeb phase at force-carrier torus knot T(p, k)
Doubly-magic \mathfrak{B} = \rho_F \cdot \mathfrak{m}_e \cdot A \cdot 8G Borromean residue prefactor \times nucleon count, no per-knot evaluation

The dispatch is determined by the substrate: Conjecture (diagrammatic double-magic): LR-fusion rigidity at Z, N \in \mathfrak{M} proves that at a doubly-magic level A = Z + N with both Z, N \in \mathfrak{M}, the Littlewood–Richardson fusion of the Z-block and N-block collapses to a single self-conjugate Specht module — there is no Wedderburn channel to absorb further binding through Hecke crossings. The per-rep Reeb phase mechanism that generates \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}} vanishes (no hyperbolic knot), and the binding is set by the universal Borromean residue 8G scaled by nucleon count.

Strutinsky's shell correction as the categorical residue sum makes the regime split forced by the filtered-algebra structure: the decomposition

  \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w, q_0) = \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{gr}}(\sigma(T_w), q_0) + \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{GB}}(T_w, q_0)

identifies the Strutinsky shell correction \delta E_{\mathrm{shell}} with the Gröbner–Shirshov residue sum, and "Magic-number enhancements arise algebraically when \lambda reaches a rectangular shape and H_q(\lambda) factorises" (Schur-Weyl justification of shell-operator self-duality). The doubly-magic case is exactly this rectangular-spike limit.

\rho_F for ^4_2\mathrm{He}

The substrate-determined prefactor for ^4_2\mathrm{He} is \rho_F = 2, sourced from the canonical the canonical formalism entry 2·m_e·4·Vol(L6a4). The categorical derivation of the integer 2 — vs. [2]_q, 2\cos(\pi/3), or another natural candidate — is not closed in this proposition; the value is consumed as an input hypothesis of the doubly-magic light-nucleus binding formula.

canonical witness

the canonical formalism emits a comparison witness showing the alpha-shift vs. magic-A predictions side-by-side for A \in \{2, 3, 4\}. The comparison quantifies the 80\times gap closure for ^4_2\mathrm{He}.
